name: Rhythm
tagline: A habit tracker for routines, without guilt-driven gimmicks
description: For people who want routines that fit a real week, not a perfect one. Flexible schedules and skip days keep streaks honest, so one sick day doesn't undo months of work.
features: Four schedule types: daily, specific weekdays, N times per week, every N days
Yes or no and measurable targets, with one-tap completion and a quick log
Skip days that never break a streak, and backfilling from a week grid
Current and best streaks, year heatmaps, a 12-week trend and best weekday
Daily journal, plus reminders that fall back in-app when notifications are blocked
JSON and CSV export, and validated JSON import with undo
engineering: Every schedule type compiles to a list of periods with a required count, so the same pure functions compute streaks and rates for all four, using whole-number day indexes that a DST change can't shift.
